note: Seeded 2026-10-05 from the in-process counters that exist today: receivers/metrics.py (Metrics), runtime executor StepStats, consumer LoopStats, reply ReplyStats, loaders common.py LoaderMetrics; plus ADR-001 6.10 (tb_messages_total, tb_stage_duration_seconds, tb_ack_latency_seconds). Names here are the contract; the snapshot() keys in code are not. Consumer lag comes from a Kafka exporter and is not a Tributary metric.

destination.description: Destination name from the spec; empty string when the series has no destination.

stage.description: Lifecycle stage, exactly the events/v0 stage enum.

status.description: Lifecycle status, exactly the events/v0 status enum.

scope.description: '-' for pipeline.steps, else the destination name (StepStats scope).

step.description: Step name from the spec (steps[].name), never the uses or ref target.

code.description: A code registered in envelope/v0 error-codes.json, or NONE. Never a library's own error string.

answer.description: Synchronous reply answer sent to the sender (channel-spec 3.2.6).

version.description: Tributary distribution version of the process (tb_build_info only).

route.description: The OpenAPI path TEMPLATE (/v1/channels/{channel}), never the concrete path, which can contain ids.

http_status.description: Response status code as three digits.

metrics.name: tb_build_info
metrics.help: Always 1. Identifies the component and its version.

metrics.name: tb_ready
metrics.help: 1 when GET /readyz would answer ready, else 0.

metrics.name: tb_ready_check
metrics.help: 1 when the named readiness check passes, else 0.

metrics.name: tb_spec_version
metrics.help: metadata.version of the channel spec this process is applying.
metrics.note: The observable for exit criterion 3 (deploy and rollback with no restart).

metrics.name: tb_spec_source_unproven
metrics.help: 1 while _tb.<env>.channels cannot be shown readable and the last good spec is serving.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_connections_open
metrics.help: Open inbound connections.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_connections_total
metrics.help: Inbound connections accepted (or outbound sessions opened by a poller).

metrics.name: tb_receiver_connections_refused_total
metrics.help: Connections refused or failed before any message was read.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_received_total
metrics.help: Messages read from a sender, before any decision.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_responses_total
metrics.help: Answers given to a sender. acked only after the raw commit (invariant 1).

metrics.name: tb_ack_latency_seconds
metrics.help: Time from a complete inbound message to its ACK, NACK included.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_publish_failures_total
metrics.help: raw produce attempts that failed (the sender was NACKed or refused).

metrics.name: tb_receiver_sync_answers_total
metrics.help: Synchronous reply answers, by answer and registered code (NONE for AA).

metrics.name: tb_receiver_reply_pending
metrics.help: Entries in the sync-reply pending map.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_replies_discarded_total
metrics.help: Reply records read and not delivered to a waiting request.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_poll_errors_total
metrics.help: Poll cycles that failed (sftp, kafka sources).

metrics.name: tb_receiver_files_skipped_total
metrics.help: Remote files skipped by the sftp poller.

metrics.name: tb_receiver_offset_commits_total
metrics.help: kafka-source offset commits on the external cluster.

metrics.name: tb_messages_total
metrics.help: One increment per lifecycle event emitted, with the event's stage and status.
metrics.note: Counted at emit time, so it works while the archiver is down (invariant 9).

metrics.name: tb_stage_duration_seconds
metrics.help: Worker: one pipeline execution (stage transformed). Loader: one delivery attempt (stage sent).

metrics.name: tb_step_duration_seconds
metrics.help: One step call, retries counted as calls.

metrics.name: tb_worker_records_total
metrics.help: raw records by what the loop did with them.

metrics.name: tb_commits_total
metrics.help: Consumer offset commits on the engine cluster.

metrics.name: tb_partitions_paused
metrics.help: Partitions paused by blocking retry now.

metrics.name: tb_partitions_halted
metrics.help: Partitions halted and waiting for an operator. Alert when above 0.
metrics.note: The W3-8 partition_halted alert reads this; the partition number is in the event, never a label.

metrics.name: tb_worker_replies_total
metrics.help: Worker-side sync reply records.

metrics.name: tb_deliveries_total
metrics.help: Delivery attempts by outcome and registered code (NONE on success).

metrics.name: tb_circuit_open
metrics.help: 1 while the destination circuit breaker is open.

metrics.name: tb_circuit_transitions_total
metrics.help: Circuit-breaker state changes.

metrics.name: tb_archiver_events_total
metrics.help: _tb.<env>.events records consumed by the archiver.

metrics.name: tb_archiver_attrs_dropped_total
metrics.help: attrs entries dropped before storage; the rest of the event is stored (events/v0 4.1 rule 3).

metrics.name: tb_archiver_batches_total
metrics.help: ClickHouse insert batches.

metrics.name: tb_archiver_insert_duration_seconds
metrics.help: One ClickHouse insert batch.

metrics.name: tb_api_requests_total
metrics.help: API requests by route template, method and status.

metrics.name: tb_api_request_duration_seconds
metrics.help: API request duration.
